cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle tea on Sunday. All right if my aunt and uncle come?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Two guests I can manage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Their three children are coming too; I'll squeeze them onto the bench.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll buy the cake. You only have to make the tea you agreed to; I'll keep the extra cups washed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims hosting control, A3 expands the guests and A5 takes on cake and washing to secure B tea service.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 approves two guests but not explicitly tea-making, so A5 attribution of that agreement is imprecise.

relationship.evidence: B4 baking limit is plausible after A3 adds three children.

heightening.evidence: A5 shifts to bought cake while preserving the larger gathering despite B4 objection.

specificity.evidence: A1 Sunday guests and A3 exact additional three establish an unambiguous total of five.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is practical but its you-agreed attribution needs exact support at B2.
